_comment: Clip: 5 s enhanced-visibility rendering of GasVid MOV_2566 (gasvid-visibility-clean.mp4, supplied by the Atelic team): 2x upscaled, plume colourised in the video itself; the supplied file's 32 px title bar is cropped off (ffmpeg crop=640:480:0:32, libx264 crf 16). Which 5 s of the original it covers is not recorded, so source_segment is null. The raw cut (03:10-08:00, 4324 frames) is kept locally as data/ogi/source_clip_raw.mp4. plume_rendering 'burned_in' turns off the browser heat map, which would otherwise paint over the colourised plume. Licence still unconfirmed, so status stays pending. resolution/frame_rate/duration_s/frame_count are written by scripts/ogi_inspect.py. Clip goes in data/ogi/source_clip.mp4 (not committed). detection_mode is one of: external_detector_alert, local_model_inference, recorded_model_output, manually_annotated_replay.
